I don't have a name yet. I have no idea where I was born. All I remember is that I was meowing in a dim and damp place. It was there that I first saw a human. I later heard that this human was a student, the most ferocious kind of human. They say these students sometimes catch us, cook us, and eat us. At the time, however, I had no idea what was happening, so I was not particularly frightened.
